cohort: The study included 64 very preterm infants with a gestational age less than 32 weeks.
finding: This study confirmed that different feeding types, delivery modes, and maternal antibiotic use during pregnancy significantly affect the gut microbiota composition of very preterm infants.
mod_finding: The abundance of Proteobacteria was high in both cesarean (92.7%) and spontaneous (55.5%) delivery groups, shifting to Firmicutes after the first week of birth.
